title: Custom calculator folder
description: Folder scanned for .wasm calculator modules (not recursive). Each file's name becomes its id. Leave empty for <vosu data directory>/tool-data/server-pp/calculators (on Linux ~/.local/share/vosu/tool-data/server-pp/calculators).

title: Additional calculator files
description: One .wasm path per line, optionally as `id = path` to choose the id. Relative paths are resolved against the calculator folder. Lines starting with # are ignored.

title: Enabled calculators
description: Calculator ids to enable, one per line. * enables every discovered calculator.

title: Display names
description: Optional `id = Display name` lines. Without one, the module's own name is shown.

title: Instruction budget per calculation (millions)
description: A calculator that executes more WebAssembly instructions than this is stopped. Typical formulas use well under 0.1 million.

title: Memory limit per calculator (MiB)
description: Largest linear memory a calculator may have or grow to (1 to 1024).
